quindĕcim-prīmi , ōrum,
I.the board of fifteen chief magistrates in the municipia, in MSS. abbrev. XV. primi: “evocat ad se Caesar Massiliensium XV. primos,” Caes. B. C. 1, 35, 1 ; so perh. also Inscr. Murat. 626, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
